question: UserCard loads the name from the network. This test fails. What's the fix?
say: User card loads the name from the network. This test fails. What's the fix?
explanation: The name isn't on screen yet when getByText runs. findBy retries until it appears (1000ms by default). queryBy would just return null.
explainSay: Await find by text. It keeps checking until the name appears, instead of looking only once.
